ticker_news.title: Your End-All, Be-All Playbook on the Road to Success: How A Truck Driver Became A VP of a Fortune 500 Company
ticker_news.description: Dan Leonardi, a former truck driver, shares his journey to becoming a Vice President at a Fortune 500 company without a college degree. His new book, 'Be the CEO of Your Life,' provides a roadmap for readers to seize control of their lives and achieve their goals.
ticker_news.author: Dan Leonardi

ticker_news.title: New Book THE TIME DOCTORS Unravels the Mystery of True Work-Life Balance
ticker_news.description: Husband-and-wife physicians Rachel and Christopher Domarew have published a new book, 'The Time Doctors,' which shares their strategies for managing professional and personal responsibilities efficiently and maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
ticker_news.author: Rachel Domarew And Christopher Domarew
